descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S24 「本地栈上的真手机：点卡片、删除弹窗和提示，以及错的设备时钟」 Real phone on the local stack: card tap, delete pop-up and toast, and a wrong device clock

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 5）
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK.（TFA-92579 AC 7）
  • T6 On delete, a confirmation message in the same app-style UI says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted".（TFA-92579 AC 8）
  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 4；UAT 3.8）
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given A debug build bundled for the local stack, never a store build: Android, the APK with the adb reverse 4510/4511 setup scripts/android-lane.ts uses; iOS, an Xcode debug build whose Capacitor server points at the host's Vite 6473 / Convex 4510. …

When Tap cards; open the delete pop-up, Cancel, then OK on a throwaway synthetic patient; then set the phone's date one day ahead and its time zone to UTC−10, reopen the app and compare the cards with the web on the same account

Then Same behaviour as S01/S02/S16/S17; the pop-up and toast look like the app, not a system alert; with the wrong clock the day/visit number, badge and 'New today' match the web (3.8)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Tester compares with the S16/S17 checkpoints and with the web (S08). A badge mismatch on the wrong clock is known: TFA-92584 AC 8; a day/visit number or 'New today' mismatch reports against TFA-92579 AC 3/4

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both (debug build on the local stack, or the store/TestFlight build on dev) 跑；来源：dev。
